'''Paqwepor Major''', also known as '''Paqwepor''', or '''Paqwepori''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] off the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. It was within the region of [[Paqwepori]].<ref name="TEA" /> Paqwepor Major was the [[Paqwe]] [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] and it was ruled by the [[Paqwe family]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Paqwepor Major was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />
